name: Gudbrandsdalsleden (Lillehammer-Dovre)
description_md:
Gudbrandsdalsleden (Lillehammer-Dovre) is a hard waymarked hiking route in Norway covering a distance of 161.9 km. The route requires about 53 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule and belongs to the national waymarked hiking network.

The path features 4691 m of ascent and 4406 m of descent, with the difficulty derived from distance and ascent. The line matches the official route published by turrutebasen. Walkers will find that the route passes Lillehammer station within 100 m and Lillehammer within 100 m.
